description: Phase 4 audit of the network's estimated parameters: every traffic-light program and every edge speed, separated by provenance.
estimation_basis: The audit reads the converted network and reports what is there. The parameters it describes are estimates: traffic-light programs were generated by netconvert from its defaults, and edge speeds were supplied by its type map wherever OpenStreetMap had none. Nothing was changed, and no external source was consulted.
processing_steps: Enumerated every tlLogic: phases, cycle length, green/yellow/all-red split, and green share per signal group.
Classified every edge's speed as OSM-derived or SUMO-estimated using the osmDefaults parameter netconvert writes.
Isolated edges given a default speed at or above 80 km/h.
limitations: TRAFFIC-LIGHT TIMINGS ARE NOT BENGALURU TIMINGS. Signal locations come from OSM; timings do not exist in OSM and are not published for Bengaluru. Every phase duration here is a netconvert default.
1375 of 1515 edges carry a SUMO-supplied free-flow speed. Time loss is measured against free-flow, so reported time loss is an over-estimate where the default exceeds the real limit.
166 edges were given a default of 80 km/h or more by a type map derived from European conventions.
Nothing was replaced. No source in this project supports better values, and a guess would look sourced while losing its provenance.
